_comment: Shared vocabulary for every DataPortation page and every master-data object. Extracted from the standard page (IMPACT_LABEL / IMPACT_RANK / NEEDS_REVIEW / PROFILE_FILTERS / COVERAGE_DIMS). Entity-agnostic by construction — nothing here mentions Items.

impact._comment: Migration severity. rank drives sort order; needsReview drives the review queue.

blocker.label: Blocker
blocker.definition: Import will fail or produce wrong records until resolved.

review.label: Review
review.definition: Import will succeed but a human decision is required first.

warning.label: Warning
warning.definition: Import will succeed; quality is degraded.

resolved.label: Resolved
resolved.definition: Was a blocker or review item; a decision has been applied.

na.label: Not applicable
na.definition: Field is out of scope for this migration.

find._comment: Tone for individual finding chips on a field.

metricTone._comment: Colour for a numeral in a metric bar or an Upload stat card. ok/info/muted were added for the Upload page, whose stat cards previously used inline colours.

prov._comment: PROVENANCE — the governance primitive. Every number and sentence shown to a user must declare which of these it is. Never present ai output as fact.

ai.label: AI interpretation
ai.note: model inference — nothing is applied until approved

action.label: Action
action.note: a control the user can invoke

steps._comment: The 8-step migration wizard. THIS is the canonical list — the four earlier pages are on a stale 7-step rail with three different label sets and must be brought onto this.

profileFilters._comment: Visual filters on the profile table. Each id must match a value used in a field's categories[] array.

items.label: Identifier Candidates
items.tip: Fields the system infers may uniquely identify a record — not yet confirmed

items.label: Duplicates
items.tip: Fields containing duplicate rows or groups

items.label: Invalid Values
items.tip: Fields with values that fail validation or reference lookup

items.label: Value list detected
items.tip: Low-cardinality fields that map to a reference list

items.label: Reference Failures
items.tip: Fields whose values do not all match a target reference

items.label: Pattern Anomalies
items.tip: Fields with values that break the dominant format pattern

coverageDims._comment: The 16 dimensions the profiler computes. Shown in the coverage popover so users can see what was and was not assessed. Every one of these is data-prov=fact.

semanticRoles._comment: The role a field plays in a migration. Entity-agnostic: Items has an identifier candidate (SKU), Customers has one too (Account No). roleTip is shown on hover and must stay honest about inference.

items.label: Identifier candidate
items.tip: A field the system infers may uniquely identify each record. Not a confirmed identifier until you approve it.

items.label: Value list
items.tip: A field with a small set of repeating values that map to a target reference list.

items.label: Reference
items.tip: A pointer to a record in another target object.

cardinality._comment: Bucketing for distinct-count. Thresholds live in the profiler, not here.

drawerTabs._comment: Tabs in the field-detail drawer. A tab renders only if the field carries the data it needs — see dp-base.js buildDrawer().

mappingStatus._comment: Field Mapping (step 3) row status. Each maps onto an existing impact state so no new colours are introduced — a Blocked mapping looks exactly like a blocker field on the profile page.

Suggested.definition: Confidence is high enough to accept without individual review.

Review required.definition: A mapping is proposed but a human must confirm it.

Blocked.definition: No compatible target; the field cannot be imported as-is.

Missing target.definition: A required target field has no source field supplying it.

Excluded.definition: Deliberately left out of the migration.

mappingValidation._comment: Deterministic type/compatibility check on a proposed mapping. PROVENANCE: fact — computed from datatypes, not inferred.

mappingHandoff._comment: What still has to happen on a later step before this mapping will import cleanly. Drives the small chip under the proposed target.

mappingEvidence._comment: Evidence codes shown as chips on a mapping row. PROVENANCE: fact for name/samples/datatype/prior/required; the weighting that turns them into a confidence score is ai.
